build_rnn_state_encoder: build a GRU or LSTM RNN state encoder with specified input and hidden sizes
create_gru_state_encoder: create a GRUStateEncoder with configurable input size, hidden size, and number of layers
create_lstm_state_encoder: create an LSTMStateEncoder that packs and unpacks hidden and cell states
run_rnn_seq_forward: run the RNN state encoder on a sequence of inputs with episode boundary masks
run_rnn_single_forward: run the RNN state encoder on a single timestep input with hidden state masking
